subject: Redeploy FTE to Senior MLOps — Offer authority & comp-band exception
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Redeploy FTE to Senior MLOps — request + comp-band exception

Hi team,

Following up on the vacant infra slot (SRE II) from the Oct 30 attrition — I'd like to propose we redeploy that FTE to Senior MLOps (platform team) rather than open an external headcount search. We have a strong passive candidate sourced by Valence (Carlos Mendez) with MLOps + infra experience and immediate availability (2–3 weeks).

Quick summary:
- Role: Senior MLOps (reports to Platform MLOps lead)
- Candidate: Carlos Mendez (resume attached)
- Comp ask: base $195,000, total cash expectation ~ $210k (incl. bonus).
- Current comp band for comparable roles (Senior IC band) tops at $180,000 base.

Ask: HR approval to redeploy the existing FTE (vacant SRE II slot) to Senior MLOps, and approval for a comp-band exception / offer authority to extend up to $195k base (approx. 8.3% over band top). If finance requires, I can propose offsetting through reduced hiring in Q1 or pulling from the infra bench budget.

I've attached a short comp-band recommendation (draft) and Carlos's resume. Please let me know if you need a formal justification doc or budget code. If there are no objections, HR/Irene — please advise next steps for formally authorizing the offer.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Eng Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redeploy FTE to Senior MLOps — request + comp-band exception

Thanks Vivek — I pulled the vacancy and verified it has been open since 2026-10-30 (headcount ID HC-PLAT-049). A couple of process notes and items needed to proceed: 

1) Please confirm budget code where the cost should be charged (or confirm you want to reassign the SRE II budget to Platform MLOps).
2) We require written justification for a comp-band exception: business rationale, candidate scarcity, and alternatives considered. A short paragraph from you is fine.
3) Finance must sign off on the run-rate impact before offer authority is granted (cc'd Markus).
4) HR will need final approval matrix filled (I attached approval_matrix.xlsx) and the proposed offer letter template to route to legal if we exceed policy thresholds.

Proposal from HR (for discussion): base + annual bonus at target 10%, 4-year RSU schedule pro-rated, and a $15k sign-on if necessary to bridge counteroffers. If you want the sign-on, note it in the justification.

I attached the approval matrix and added Vivek's comp-band draft to the packet. Once we have budget code and Markus's nod, I can route to Laura for final headcount confirmation.

If we can turn this around quickly, I can issue a conditional offer and include a DocuSign link for the candidate.

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Talent Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redeploy FTE to Senior MLOps — request + comp-band exception

Irene/Vivek —

I reviewed the numbers. Approve in principle pending confirmation of the budget code and that this is a like-for-like redeploy (i.e., we are not creating an additional net FTE). On the numbers: if we grant $195k base + 10% target bonus + $15k sign-on, the first-year cash + sign-on impact is ~ $225k and the incremental annual run-rate versus the original SRE II slot (~$140k base) is ~ $80k.

Please provide the budget code and indicate if there is headcount capacity in the Platform pool (HC-PLAT). I will provisionally approve a one-time sign-on up to $15k; anything above requires finance leadership sign-off.

Markus
Director, Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redeploy FTE to Senior MLOps — request + comp-band exception

Thanks all for the thread and details. I support redeploying the vacant SRE II slot to Senior MLOps for Platform. Approve headcount move HC-PLAT-049 -> HC-PLAT-SR-MLOPS.

Offer authority: you have approval to extend an offer to Carlos Mendez up to $200,000 base, with up to $20,000 sign-on (if needed) and standard equity package as proposed by HR. Please document the business case in the approval matrix (Vivek), and charge to budget code PLAT-OPS-2026-Q4.

No objections on my end — get HR to prepare the formal offer and include the contingency for background and reference checks. CC me on the final DocuSign so I can confirm acceptance.

Laura Bennett

Subject: Offer authorization confirmed — next steps (Carlos Mendez)

Julia/Carlos — thanks for patience. Per approvals on the internal thread: Laura has authorized redeploying the vacant SRE II slot to Senior MLOps and granted offer authority. HR is authorized to extend a formal offer to Carlos with the following parameters:

- Role: Senior MLOps (Platform)
- Base: $195,000 (approved; within offer authority up to $200k)
- Sign-on: up to $20,000 discretionary (we anticipate $15k if used)
- Bonus: target 10%
- Equity: 4-year RSU schedule (to be detailed in letter)
- Budget code: PLAT-OPS-2026-Q4

Attached: candidate_resume_carlos_mendez.pdf, comp_band_recommendation_20261115.pdf, approval_matrix.xlsx

Next steps:
1) Julia — please confirm Carlos's current notice period and preferred start date so we can populate the offer letter.
2) I'll generate the DocuSign offer (link below) and route for signature.
3) Conditional on standard background/reference checks; we will run these once candidate signs.

DocuSign link (will go live after I upload the finalized letter): https://app.docusign.com/ABC123-offer
